Recorded claim:
`lib/hg.mjs` was replaced by `lib/git.mjs` with Git status parsing, branch creation, commit/amend, stash/rebase, checkpoint refs, changed-file discovery, and commit-message revision lookup. `tb create` uses `git switch -c Bug-...`; `tb try` invokes `../mach try`; `tb land` and `tb bump` invoke Lando. [Task 1]
